record.title: Prove legacy authority identity and historical-contract conformance
record.intent: Pressure-test historical authority, identity collisions and old evidence after related-ledger lessons are incorporated.
requirements: Use reviewed historical or representative fixtures with explicit provenance. Preserve historical identity/evidence without retrospectively declaring a legacy dialect native.
This is taskctl compatibility work using isolated specimens or fixtures. Operational adoption, copied-tool retirement and consumer integration remain tasks owned by each consumer repository.
acceptance: Conformance covers ambiguous identities, exact source revisions, old-contract evidence and later changed contracts before the native-v1 assessment.
Preserve the recorded prerequisite gates; this task does not itself authorize consumer migration, protocol freeze or service implementation.
